files.description: Exam scores (60 rows, one per student): student (full name, unique, many with accented letters), then math, art and music (scores 35-100, whole numbers; about 9% of these score cells are empty, and one student has no score at all).

task_text: For each subject, what share of the recorded scores (cells that have a score) is below 50? `result` should be a Series indexed by subject (math, art, music) with shares between 0 and 1.
intended_computation: Per subject, the number of non-empty scores below 50 divided by the number of non-empty scores of that subject (math 16/55, art 8/54, music 12/55).

acceptable_variants.notes: shares may be rounded to 6 significant digits.

predicted_direction.reason: After stack(), the mean of (score < 50) per subject used only recorded scores on 2.x; on 3.x the empty cells stay in the stacked data and count as 'not below 50', lowering the shares.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R04; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
